description: Factory annual work calendars and compatible timezone
statements: ALTER TABLE factories ADD COLUMN timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Shanghai'

CREATE TABLE factory_calendars (id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,company_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,factory_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,year INT NOT NULL CHECK(year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100),status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),remark VARCHAR(2000),activated_at DATETIME(6),created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),created_by CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_by CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,UNIQUE(factory_id,year),FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),INDEX(company_id,factory_id,status)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE calendar_week_patterns (id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,calendar_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,valid_from DATE NOT NULL,valid_to DATE NOT NULL,work_days JSON NOT NULL,CHECK(valid_to>valid_from),CHECK(JSON_SCHEMA_VALID('{"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":7},"uniqueItems":true,"maxItems":7}',work_days)),FOREIGN KEY(calendar_id) REFERENCES factory_calendars(id),INDEX(calendar_id,valid_from)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE calendar_exceptions (calendar_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,date DATE NOT NULL,day_type VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(day_type IN ('WORK','REST')),note VARCHAR(500),PRIMARY KEY(calendar_id,date),FOREIGN KEY(calendar_id) REFERENCES factory_calendars(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin
